title: A new test never reads the checkout's own origin/main, so a merge that moves main cannot turn a ready run red
why: INCIDENT (coordinator 23:57 CST Nov 14, relayed to triage as data; its read unless marked): PR #3448 (branch rct-carry-main-merge, step carry-forgives-main-merge, lane review-carries-by-tree) had a ready run, run 43682083778 at head c6b4139f1d62, marked 23:41 CST. Its job checks-merge-git went red at 23:55:52 CST (REST read; the run itself is still in progress). Per runner 10's read of that job's log, four new tests in the PR read the checkout's real origin/main (stale_tip_fixture asserts main_tip() equals fx.M), and #3438's merge at 23:49:53 CST moved main during the run, so the assertion failed. The PR had passed the lane's own runs, three review rounds and the lane lint. About 14 min of CI wasted (23:41 to 23:55, the coordinator's arithmetic, one run, n=1). MISTAKE (building-guard-needs-incident): a test fixture depends on the live remote of the checkout it runs in, so its result changes when another PR merges. HARM IT STOPS: a red ready run after a moving main, which costs a CI cycle and holds the PR's hand-in. GUARD (either; the first act of the lane is to pick one and name why): (1) a check that fails a test or fixture that reads the checkout's own origin/main (or main_tip() of the real checkout) instead of the fixture's own bare origin; or (2) a line in the reviewer's brief: probe each new test for a dependency on the live remote (state that moves with other merges). A check must pass the scanner rules (comment openers inside strings) and must go red on this incident's fixture first (verification-trust-guard-after-red). READ BY TRIAGE (REST, 23:59 CST): PR #3448 is open, draft, head c6b4139f1d629ef95892f08f7ce1e56e6b17a956, base main dc35317d3b40, 12 commits, 2 files changed. Run 43682083778 (event pull_request, head c6b4139f1d629ef95892f08f7ce1e56e6b17a956, created 05:40:26Z): the RUN reads status in_progress, no conclusion, updated 05:57:09Z (other jobs still going). The JOB checks-merge-git (id 132714887666), step "Merge tool git-half fixture suite", reads conclusion failure, completed 05:55:52Z (23:55:52 CST). So the red is a job verdict; the run has no conclusion yet. Read by REST (coordinator 23:58 CST, repeated by this triage's fork 00:00 CST). The four-test cause (stale_tip_fixture, "the checkout's origin/main moved") is runner 10's read of the job's log: neither the coordinator nor triage read it. A later green run on the same head exists for lane-touched-tests only (run 43683185992, success, 05:56:12Z, the coordinator's read). CAUSE per the #3448 lane's own read of job 132714887666 (00:00 CST Nov 14, lane report relayed by the coordinator; neither the coordinator nor triage read the log): 4 failed of 1711, one assertion at merge/test_merge.py:15438 (self.main_tip() != fx.M), main_tip() a different sha in each (51008c09f157, 2dd96fa13e04, e4ab0f90e480, 66c24cc2842a); the fixture depends on its checkout's origin/main. The runner's git is 2.56.1; the "silent-undo UNKNOWN (git older than 2.38)" line comes from a scripted fake git in another test, so it is not a runner-git cause. Not read by triage: the test file, stale_tip_fixture, the job log. RELATED: lane review-carries-by-tree is fixing the fixture now (coordinator 23:57). No design lane yet.
